sources.snippet: Qwen 3.5-122B-A10B: multi-GPU territory The 122B is the model for people who have more hardware than patience. 122 billion total parameters, 10 billion active per token (8 routed + 1 shared from 256 experts).

sources.title: Qwen3.5 122B-A10B · Models · The Open-Source AI Stack
sources.snippet: A mid-size Qwen3.5 mixture-of-experts: 122B total with about 10B active per token. The large footprint needs a high-capacity box, while the 10B active count keeps single-stream decode brisk; it is often run at IQ4_XS for long-context work.
